blueprint_adherence.description: Artifact visibly follows the pinned Blueprint/product expression and intended subject.

aesthetic_coherence.description: Composition, visual hierarchy, consistency and overall presentation are coherent.

commercial_usefulness.description: Artifact is readable/useful for the intended buyer or downstream licensing use case.

ai_artifact_quality.description: No obvious generative defects materially reduce usable quality.

use_case_fitness.description: Artifact fits the declared customer/job-to-be-done and intended asset class.

similarity_distinctness.description: Artifact is sufficiently distinct from sibling outputs for the intended batch.

readability_composition.description: Important visual/textual elements are legible and compositionally usable.
